purpose: Frozen three-release issue contracts. PROJECT-TRACKER.md owns live execution; GitHub mirrors these approved finite outcomes. This record is not a second independent status queue.

R1.title: R1 — Configurable Desktop Lite
R1.goal: Ship all currently planned desktop features, finish existing evaluations and implement accepted choices, with bounded resource use and required release quality.

R2.title: R2 — Maintenance and Runtime Simplification
R2.goal: Finish the finite remaining source/runtime legacy cleanup, measured optimization and worker-hardening contracts, preserving R1 features.

R3.title: R3 — Developer Tooling and Deferred Work
R3.goal: Complete the finite first-party developer-tool migration and eligible parked followups; later new features enter only through explicit finite intake.

classification.Major: Substantive feature, cross-component/native-contract change, migration or broad qualification. This is work breadth, not severity or a time estimate.
classification.Minor: Bounded local cleanup, documentation, polish or test/profile task with no broad architecture migration. R1 Minor tasks are still release requirements.

evaluation_policy: Finish each existing evaluation in R1. Adopt requires qualified accepted integration before the affected R1 contract closes; defer/reject may retain the current baseline with explicit rationale and finite followup. No dependency is adopted merely by scheduling.
